WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS ty_year, 'FY2025/26' AS ly_year, 1 AS first_week, 22 AS last_week
),
range_start AS (
    SELECT MIN(d.calendar_date) AS first_day
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND d.fiscal_week = params.first_week
),
weeks AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
),
store_weeks AS (
    SELECT st.store_id, w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week,
           (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= w.fiscal_week_start_date)
           AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= w.fiscal_week_end_date)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                           WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id
                             AND c.closure_start_date <= w.fiscal_week_end_date
                             AND c.closure_end_date >= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
    FROM dim_store st
    CROSS JOIN weeks w
    WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
),
lfl_store_weeks AS (
    SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week
    FROM store_weeks ty
    CROSS JOIN params
    CROSS JOIN range_start
    JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
    JOIN dim_store st   ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current
    WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
      AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= range_start.first_day - 364)
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
lfl_sales AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT n.store_id) AS stores
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
    GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, cs.region
)
SELECT ty.region, ty.stores, ty.net_sales AS this_year, ly.net_sales AS last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales DESC) AS rnk
FROM lfl_sales ty
CROSS JOIN params
JOIN lfl_sales ly ON ly.region = ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year
ORDER BY rnk;

WITH mine AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, s.store_id, SUM(x.v) AS mine
    FROM (
      SELECT f.sale_date AS dt, f.store_key, f.net_amount AS v FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      UNION ALL
      SELECT r.return_date, r.store_key, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key WHERE p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    ) x
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = x.store_key
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = x.dt
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 22 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26')
    GROUP BY 1,2
),
ctl AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, c.store_id, SUM(c.net_sales) AS ctl
    FROM rpt_daily_store_sales c JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = c.business_date
    WHERE c.store_id < 900 AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 22 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26')
    GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT COALESCE(m.fiscal_year,c.fiscal_year) fy, COALESCE(m.store_id,c.store_id) store_id, m.mine, c.ctl, ROUND(m.mine-c.ctl,2) diff,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) FROM fact_sales_line) AS dup_sales_lines,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT return_line_id) FROM fact_return_line) AS dup_return_lines
FROM mine m FULL JOIN ctl c ON m.fiscal_year=c.fiscal_year AND m.store_id=c.store_id
WHERE ABS(COALESCE(m.mine,0)-COALESCE(c.ctl,0)) > 1
ORDER BY 1,2;

WITH mine AS (
    SELECT x.dt, SUM(x.v) AS mine, COUNT(*) n
    FROM (
      SELECT f.sale_date AS dt, f.store_key, f.net_amount AS v FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      UNION ALL
      SELECT r.return_date, r.store_key, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key WHERE p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    ) x
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = x.store_key
    WHERE s.store_id = 116 AND x.dt BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2025-09-28'
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT COALESCE(m.dt, c.business_date) dt, m.mine, m.n, c.net_sales ctl, c.net_sales_before_returns, c.returns_net, ROUND(COALESCE(m.mine,0)-COALESCE(c.net_sales,0),2) diff,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) FROM fact_sales_line) dup_rl
FROM mine m FULL JOIN (SELECT * FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=116 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2025-09-28') c ON c.business_date = m.dt
WHERE ABS(COALESCE(m.mine,0)-COALESCE(c.net_sales,0)) > 0.5
ORDER BY 1;

WITH g AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no, COUNT(*) c, MIN(sales_line_id) mn, MAX(sales_line_id) mx, MIN(sale_date) d1, MAX(sale_date) d2,
         COUNT(DISTINCT net_amount) nets, COUNT(DISTINCT store_key) sk, MIN(etl_loaded_at) l1, MAX(etl_loaded_at) l2
  FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1
)
SELECT s.store_id, COUNT(*) dup_groups, MAX(c) maxc, MIN(g.d1) first_date, MAX(g.d2) last_date, MAX(nets) max_distinct_nets, MAX(sk) max_store_keys, MIN(l1) minload, MAX(l2) maxload,
  SUM((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_return_line r WHERE r.sales_line_id = g.mn)) ret_on_first,
  SUM((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_return_line r WHERE r.sales_line_id = g.mx)) ret_on_last
FROM g JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = g.mn JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

           AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= w.fiscal_week_end_date)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                           WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id
                             AND c.closure_start_date <= w.fiscal_week_end_date
                             AND c.closure_end_date >= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
    FROM dim_store st
    CROSS JOIN weeks w
    WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900

lfl_store_weeks AS (
    SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week

    CROSS JOIN params
    CROSS JOIN range_start

    JOIN dim_store st   ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current
    WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
      AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= range_start.first_day - 364)
),
sales_dedup AS (
    -- store 116 has every line of 15-21 Sep 2025 loaded twice; keep the first row per receipt line
    SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY sales_line_id) = 1
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM sales_dedup f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
lfl_sales AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
    GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, cs.region
)
SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales DESC) AS rank, ty.region,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct,
       ty.net_sales AS ty_net, ly.net_sales AS ly_net
FROM lfl_sales ty
CROSS JOIN params
JOIN lfl_sales ly ON ly.region = ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year
ORDER BY rank;
